lines: Mira had just put their first map away. Then a parcel rolled down the library ramp.
A new parcel! Let’s open it and see what is inside.
The card says: Take the Moon Lantern to the balcony before the first evening star. Let’s carry it to the workshop door.
The friends carried the lantern to the workshop. It was too wide for the door.
Hello! I’m Pax. I help things fit together. First, find the lantern with every part in place.
That is the whole lantern. Every part is here. There is no gap and no extra piece.
Four blue tiles lit up on the bridge. Each tile needed one footprint.
I touched one tile twice. It flashed red. Can you touch every tile once?
You touched four different tiles, one time each. Now the bridge is ready.
The lantern was still too wide for the next door. Pax showed three ways to take it apart.
Find four same-size pieces that fill the circle. There must be no gap and no piece on top of another.
Those four parts fill the circle. They are the same size, and none cover each other.
All four lantern parts sat on a tray beside an empty circle.
Let’s put every part into the circle. Use each part one time.
The four parts fit together. The lantern is whole again, and the tray is empty.
Two pairs of circles appeared on the table.
One pair has parts that are the same size. Check both pairs before you choose.
Pair A has same-size parts. Pair B has one big part and one small part.
Three parts were in the lantern. One space was empty. A lantern part and a triangle were nearby.
First fill the empty space. Then put any piece that does not belong outside the lantern.
The lantern part filled the gap. The triangle stayed outside because it is extra. Now the lantern is whole.
Pax held some parts. The whole lantern still had four spaces.
How many parts am I holding? Then tell me how many parts make the whole lantern.
Pax is holding two parts. Four parts make the whole lantern. The two numbers answer different questions.
Before they put the lantern on its stand, Tavi remembered Sol’s first try on the bridge.
What did Sol do on his first try? Choose the footprints you remember. Then put the lantern on its stand.
Sol touched one tile twice. This time we checked every part once. The whole Moon Lantern shines on the balcony!
